digest.component_or_area: snapshot-entry schema and fetcher contract enforcement
propositions: The snapshot-entry contract is defined outside the enforced schema machinery in a hand-rolled Python module that no production code imports, causing divergence to go undetected.
The existing schema validation and type-generation drift gate covers ~90 sibling schemas via jsonschema and generated TypedDict, but the snapshot contract is exempt from this enforcement.
Real snapshot fixture data exists in bridge_state/snapshots/ but is gitignored and contains PII, so a redacted fixture covering all entry shapes must be added to the tracked test fixtures.
A fetcher field change that diverges from the snapshot contract should fail CI validation, but currently does not because the contract is unenforced.
